  constructor
  · rintro ⟨x, y, hx, hy, h⟩; exact ⟨x, y, hx, hy, h⟩
  · rintro ⟨x, y, hx, hy, h⟩; exact ⟨x, y, hx, hy, h⟩
target_source: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K] (I J : nonZeroDivisors (Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K))), ClassGroup.mk0 I = ClassGroup.mk0 J ↔ ∃ x y : NumberField.RingOfIntegers K, x ≠ 0 ∧ y ≠ 0 ∧ Ideal.span {x} * (I : Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) = Ideal.span {y} * J
